## What landed

### C1 producers (`hh-compiler`; ADR-0339 D4)

- `bind_composite` mints `PlanMap` bindings — `mapping.kind =
  plan_map` + pinned `plan_ref`, S1 inclusion over invoked
  capabilities, `effects_bound` = union of declared effects;
  undeclared-effects invoke → `UncheckableSurface`, an invoke outside
  the capability allowlist → `AuthorityWidening`. Composite bindings
  round-trip the canonical codec (schema.rs `plan_map` leg).
- `bind_variant` stamps identity-bearing `family_id`/`variant_id`
  provenance on the binding record; `check_family` requires the
  back-pointer. Provenance members never widen the `surface_id`
  basis (ADR-0339 D4 — a variant change that alters rendering mints
  a new id through the members already in the basis).
- Non-surface `IndexGranularity` (`namespace`/`source`/`catalog`)
  aggregates member search text into unit rows; `index_query_decl`
  answers only at the declared granularity (`NotQueryable` on a
  mismatch) and expands unit hits back to member `surface_id`s.
- All eight `CatalogIndex` variants execute: `exact_name`,
  `static_allowlist`, `lexical_regex` (with `invalid_pattern`
  typed refusal), `bm25`, `hierarchical`, plus executor-gated
  `embedding`/`model_ranked`/`filesystem`.
- `bind_freeform`/`bind_shim` mint `parse(grammar_ref)` /
  `resolve_name(table_ref)` arg maps.
- `RenderMode::{concise,offload}` parse with declared members;
  the `preview_lines ≤ threshold_bytes` bound is checked.

### C2 gates + executor seam (D3, D5)

- `IndexExecutor{embedding?, model_ranked?, filesystem?}` binds host
  `ExecutorFn` legs (D3); an absent leg is `ExecutorUnavailable` —
  the kernel never fabricates a ranking. Executor answers carry
  `executed_by = provider`/`kernel` per the variant; a `None`-scored
  hit is rank-only.
- `check_callable` admits `from_code` calls on `code_mode` plan
  members only (D5 — the code-mode *executor* stays R-2.5.5's row).
- `PermissionGate::hide_uncovered` omits `PermissionUncovered`
  entries from every index/discovery result;
  `demote_uncovered` drops `direct` from the admission meet —
  demoted, never hidden.
- Attestation-gated indexing: `lifted` entries index only under
  `SelectionGates.index_unverified`; `pinned ∧ lifted` is
  `PinBindsLifted` at both catalog build and `adopt`.
- `ask` drift adoption: `sync_source` on an `ask`-policy source
  refuses typed (`CatalogDriftRefused`) and the driver mints
  `security.permission.requested` — the catalog holds its pre-sync
  epoch.

### The armed lane (`hh-control::driver`; D1–D2)

`DriverConfig.exposure: Option<ExposureRuntime>` arms the lane —
`None` ⇒ the C0 lane is byte-identical (zero exposure rows). Per
`propose`, in order: lazy `fold_exposure_state` over the durable
prefix (D2 — resume re-arms revealed set, prior order, delivered
artefacts; in-memory state is a cache, never authority);
once-per-run `action.tool.catalog.built`;
`select_surfaces_with` → `action.tool.exposure.planned` minted
*before* `context.assembled` (durable-before-visible — the plan row
lands ahead of the context it shaped, `DecisionPoint = retrieve`);
`context.artefact.delivered{kind: tool_surface}` once per run per
`direct` member. Every parsed call runs `check_callable` before
output validation — a refusal mints `action.tool.call.refused` and
never reaches the effect path. A `discover_surfaces` call executes
in-kernel at dispatch: `action.tool.discovery.searched` records the
query *hash* (never raw text) and `action.tool.surface.revealed`
mints per admitted hit. Retention boundaries mint
`action.tool.surface.evicted`; a called delivered surface mints
`context.artefact.activated{artefact_id = surface_id, tool_call_id}`
per call (AC-E3-7's delivered↔invoked join). Host
`sync_exposure_source` lands `catalog.delta` always, `adopt` mints
`catalog.epoch` + rebuilt `catalog.built`, `ask` mints
`security.permission.requested`.

### The corpus battery (DF-S1.17-1 residual)

- `crates/hh-compiler/tests/exposure_c1.rs` — a 244-surface catalogue
  (8 namespaces × 30 + pinned/hidden/lifted/canonical members) drives
  the AC-E3 arms: per-form retrieval, `invalid_pattern` refusal,
  hidden exclusion, `discover ⊆ indexed|deferred`, the non-surface
  granularity arms, attestation/permission gates, executor legs,
  PlanMap/variant/freeform/shim producers, concise/offload parse.
- The regex-vs-natural-language *form* fixture runs a non-`native_fc`
  shim-variant family (`r2_8_form_fixture_non_native_fc_family`) —
  ADR-0286 D7's blocker discharged.
- The S-386 provider round-trip replays provider-searched →
  `surface.revealed` → next-plan `direct` → callable
  (`r2_8_executor_legs_and_s386_provider_round_trip`).
- `crates/hh-bench/tests/r2_8_exposure.rs` — the exposure-metric
  computations run the real `retrieval_eval` machinery over
  `benchset.stage3.v1` recorded `model_io`: ToolRet-shaped
  `required_surface_ids` labelled per task; `exact_name`
  `recall@8 = 1.0` floor gated, `bm25` reported (never gated),
  deferred-share folds asserted for shape. Dev-only `hh-compiler`
  dep on `hh-bench`.

## Notes / caveats

- Size: ~4,880 changed lines vs the ticket's 1,400-line budget —
  recorded as owned deviation ADR-0339 D6 (same class as R2.5–R2.7);
  the emitters, corpus battery and C2 gates verify one coupled
  `Catalog`/`ExposurePlan` machinery.
- The `discovery.searched` payload carries the query *hash* only —
  raw query text never enters the durable record.
- The `postconditions` consumption seam stays with R2.15 (ADR-0339
  D5a) — no R2.8 member needs it; no double-owning.
- `from_code` calls are admitted but nothing at this rung produces
  them — the code-mode executor is R-2.5.5's row (D5).
